title: AlphaEarth Foundations GeoZarr Mosaic
description: A global mosaic of Google AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embeddings stored as a Zarr v3 array, covering 2017–2025 at approximately 10m resolution at the equator. Each pixel encodes a 64-dimensional learned embedding derived from satellite imagery, projected in EPSG:4326 and spanning ±83° latitude. Annual time steps (9 years) enable temporal change detection and similarity search across the full globe.
readme: ## README.md # AEF Mosaic A global mosaic of [Google AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embeddings](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/projects_sat-io_open-datasets_AEF_AlphaEarthFoundationsSatelliteEmbedding), covering 2017-2025 at ~0.00009° resolution. The dataset is projected in `EPSG:4326` with a fixed pixel size in degrees. This means that pixels cover ~10m on the ground at the equator, but less area at higher latitudes. For area-based analysis, consider reprojecting to an equal-area projection, [creating your own mosaic](https://github.com/geospatial-jeff/aef-mosaic) in a custom CRS, or using the [underlying COGs](https://source.coop/tge-labs/aef) which are already projected to UTM. This copy is not officially supported by Google. This dataset implements the following Zarr conventions. These Zarr conventions are not mature and may change. | Convention | Description | |------------|-------------| | [proj:](https://github.com/zarr-experimental/geo-proj/blob/v1/README.md) | Coordinate reference system information | | [spatial:](https://github.com/zarr-conventions/spatial/blob/v1/README.md) | Spatial coordinate and transform metadata | | [geoemb:](https://github.com/geo-embeddings/embeddings-zarr-convention/blob/add-convention/README.md) | Metadata for geo-embeddings | ## License This dataset is licensed under CC-BY 4.0 and requires the following attribution text: "The AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dataset is produced by Google and Google DeepMind." ## Visualizations ### RGB Composite PCA visualization of the embedding space projected to RGB: ### RGB PCA (Zoomed) Detailed view showing embedding structure at higher resolution: ### Cosine Similarity Similarity search using a query embedding: ### Change Detection Temporal embedding differences highlighting landscape changes: ## Quick Start ```python import zarr import numpy as np root = zarr.open_group( "s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tge-labs/aef-mosaic/", mode="r", storage_options={"anon": True} ) embeddings = root["embeddings"] # Access a spatial subset (year 0, all bands, y slice, x slice) data = embeddings[0, :, 516000:516100, 832000:832100] # De-quantize to float32 data_float = ((data / 127.5) ** 2) * np.sign(data) ``` ## Xarray ```python import xarray as xr def fetch_point(ds, lat, lon, time=0): """Fetch AEF embedding for a single lat/lon point. Returns shape (64,).""" return ds.isel(time=time).sel(x=lon, y=lat, method="nearest") def fetch_bbox(ds, bbox, time=0): """Fetch AEF embeddings for a bounding box. Returns shape (64, y, x).""" minx, miny, maxx, maxy = bbox return ds.isel(time=time).sel(x=slice(minx, maxx), y=slice(maxy, miny)) def main(): ds = xr.open_zarr( "s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tge-labs/aef-mosaic/", storage_options={"anon": True} ) # Fetch embedding for a single point lat, lon = 34.0522, -118.2437 # Los Angeles point_data = fetch_point(ds, lat, lon).compute() print(f"Point shape: {point_data.embeddings.shape}") # Fetch embeddings for a bounding box bbox = [-118.279668, 34.036242, -118.20862, 34.089643] bbox_data = fetch_bbox(ds, bbox).compute() print(f"Bbox shape: {bbox_data.embeddings.shape}") if __name__ == "__main__": main() ``` ## Zarr-python ```python import asyncio from affine import Affine from obstore.store import S3Store from zarr.storage import ObjectStore from zarr.api.asynchronous import open_group store = S3Store( "us-west-2.opendata.source.coop", prefix="tge-labs/aef-mosaic/", region="us-west-2", skip_signature=True, ) zarr_store = ObjectStore(store, read_only=True) def latlon_to_rowcol(lat, lon, transform): """Convert lat/lon to row/col using the inverse transform.""" inv = ~transform col, row = inv * (lon, lat) return int(row), int(col) def bbox_to_slices(bbox, transform): """Convert a bounding box to row/col slices.""" minx, miny, maxx, maxy = bbox inv = ~transform col1, row1 = inv * (minx, maxy) col2, row2 = inv * (maxx, miny) row_start, row_stop = int(min(row1, row2)), int(max(row1, row2)) + 1 col_start, col_stop = int(min(col1, col2)), int(max(col1, col2)) + 1 return slice(row_start, row_stop), slice(col_start, col_stop) async def fetch_point(embeddings, transform, lat, lon, year=0): """Fetch AEF embedding for a single lat/lon point. Returns shape (64,).""" row, col = latlon_to_rowcol(lat, lon, transform) return await embeddings.getitem((year, slice(None), row, col)) async def fetch_bbox(embeddings, transform, bbox, year=0): """Fetch AEF embeddings for a bounding box. Returns shape (64, rows, cols).""" row_slice, col_slice = bbox_to_slices(bbox, transform) return await embeddings.getitem((year, slice(None), row_slice, col_slice)) async def main(): root = await open_group(store=zarr_store, mode="r") embeddings = await root.get("embeddings") transform = Affine(*root.metadata.attributes["spatial:transform"]) # Fetch embedding for a single point lat, lon = 34.0522, -118.2437 # Los Angeles point_data = await fetch_point(embeddings, transform, lat, lon) print(f"Point shape: {point_data.shape}") # Fetch embeddings for a bounding box bbox = [-118.279668, 34.036242, -118.20862, 34.089643] bbox_data = await fetch_bbox(embeddings, transform, bbox) print(f"Bbox shape: {bbox_data.shape}") if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(main()) ``` ## Dataset Details | Property | Value | |----------|-------| | **Location** | `s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tge-labs/aef-mosaic/` | | **Format** | Zarr v3 with sharding | | **Shape** | `(9, 64, 1859584, 4009984)` | | **Dimensions** | `(time, band, y, x)` | | **Years** | 2017-2025 (indices 0-8) | | **Bands** | 64 embedding dimensions | | **CRS** | EPSG:4326 | | **Bbox** | `[-180.0, -83.36, 180.22, 83.69]` | | **Resolution** | ~0.00009° (~10m at equator) | | **Data Type** | int8 (quantized), nodata = -128 | | **Shard Size** | `(1, 64, 4096, 4096)` | | **Inner Chunk Size** | `(1, 64, 256, 256)` | ## Source Code The processing pipeline used to create this mosaic is available at: https://github.com/geospatial-jeff/aef-mosaic ## Contact Please send any comments, questions, or points of feedback to the [`#opening-aef`](https://cloudnativegeo.slack.com/archives/C09A8SV3WN5) CNG slack channel.
